sources.label: A collection of font-related Morphe patches to improve readability/accessibility
sources.author: Stylus
patch_list: Replaces Where is my Train's bundled Google Sans, Nunito Sans, and Roboto UI fonts with a custom font file. Optional OpenType feature settings can enable alternate digits such as Inter's ss01 open-style numbers.
Force system font (Where is my Train)
Renders the app using the device's system font instead of Google Sans / Nunito Sans.
